propositions: The completion verifier reads a stale local mirror of the ticket store (refs/heads/tickets) when called with fetch=False, causing it to miss recent ticket updates and comments visible in the live tracker.

The verifier's input context comes from the live store while its authoritative show_ticket reads come from a pinned stale snapshot, creating a two-halves disagreement where the model correctly trusts the stale data.
A non-PASS verdict with no findings is coerced to FAIL and fabricates a placeholder criterion (unspecified) instead of reporting the verifier fault through a distinct verdict_obtainable channel.

Two blocked ticket closes (wailsome-unsure-asianlion and fixable-angular-caribou) were caused by the stale snapshot presenting evidence as absent or budget-starved when evidence was actually present in the live store.
